cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(alp_native_port VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/../lib")
set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN TRUE)
option(ALP_PORT_AVX2 "Compile AVX2 profile (requires AVX2 CPU)" OFF)
option(ALP_PORT_ORACLE "Build separate unmodified upstream oracle" OFF)
option(ALP_PORT_FUZZ "Build Clang libFuzzer target" OFF)
set(ALP_PORT_SANITIZER "" CACHE STRING "address,undefined or thread")
set(ALP_UPSTREAM_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../Source/alp-cwida/upstream" CACHE PATH "Frozen unmodified source")
add_compile_options(-fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off -fno-strict-aliasing)
if(ALP_PORT_AVX2)
  add_compile_options(-mavx2)
endif()
if(ALP_PORT_SANITIZER)
  add_compile_options(-fsanitize=${ALP_PORT_SANITIZER} -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  add_link_options(-fsanitize=${ALP_PORT_SANITIZER})
endif()
set(CORE_FILES src/falp.cpp src/fastlanes_generated_ffor.cpp src/fastlanes_generated_unffor.cpp src/fastlanes_ffor.cpp src/fastlanes_unffor.cpp)
list(TRANSFORM CORE_FILES PREPEND "vendor/")
add_library(alp_port SHARED src/codec.cpp ${CORE_FILES})
target_include_directories(alp_port PUBLIC include PRIVATE vendor/include)
add_executable(alp_cli src/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(alp_cli PRIVATE alp_port)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(alp_tests tests/test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(alp_tests PRIVATE alp_port Threads::Threads)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME contract COMMAND alp_tests)
add_executable(c_consumer tests/consumer.c)
set_target_properties(c_consumer PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
target_link_libraries(c_consumer PRIVATE alp_port)
add_test(NAME c_abi COMMAND c_consumer)
if(NOT ALP_PORT_SANITIZER STREQUAL "thread")
  # Clang TSan defines its own strong operator new/delete interceptors.
  # Allocation injection is covered by release and ASan builds instead.
  add_executable(allocation_failure tests/allocation_failure.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(allocation_failure PRIVATE alp_port)
  add_test(NAME allocation_failure COMMAND allocation_failure)
endif()
if(ALP_PORT_ORACLE)
  set(ORACLE_CORE src/falp.cpp src/fastlanes_generated_ffor.cpp src/fastlanes_generated_unffor.cpp src/fastlanes_ffor.cpp src/fastlanes_unffor.cpp)
  list(TRANSFORM ORACLE_CORE PREPEND "${ALP_UPSTREAM_ROOT}/")
  add_executable(alp_upstream_oracle tests/upstream_driver.cpp ${ORACLE_CORE})
  target_include_directories(alp_upstream_oracle PRIVATE "${ALP_UPSTREAM_ROOT}/include")
endif()
if(ALP_PORT_FUZZ)
  target_compile_options(alp_port PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
  add_executable(alp_fuzz tests/fuzz.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(alp_fuzz PRIVATE alp_port)
  target_compile_options(alp_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
  target_link_options(alp_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
endif()
install(TARGETS alp_port alp_cli)
install(FILES include/alp_port.h DESTINATION include)
